jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Associate Director, Software Engineering
.
Business:IWPB Technology
Principal Responsibilities
Own the technical direction, architecture and engineering roadmap for the financial-planning platform in partnership with Product, Business and Architecture teams.
Lead by example through hands-on design, development, code review, debugging and resolution of complex production issues.
Design and deliver scalable, secure and resilient microservices and AI capabilities, including APIs, event-driven integration, AI agents, tool use, retrieval and orchestration.
Apply AI and agentic workflows across requirements, development, testing, documentation and release processes to improve delivery speed, quality, automation and cost efficiency.
Establish engineering and AI-development standards covering automated testing, CI/CD, evaluation, guardrails, observability, security and responsible use of AI.
Own delivery from requirements clarification to production, managing priorities, dependencies, technical debt, risks and stakeholder expectations.
Coach engineers, build a strong engineering culture and create reusable patterns and guidelines that help other teams adopt emerging technologies effectively.
Requirements
Deep hands-on expertise in either Java or Python, with substantial experience designing and delivering production-grade software. Java expertise should include modern Java and Spring Boot; Python expertise should include building enterprise applications or AI solutions.
Proven technical leadership experience, including setting technical direction, leading complex delivery and developing engineers in a global team environment.
Practical experience with generative AI or agentic systems, such as LLM integration, RAG, tool use, orchestration, evaluation and guardrails. Experience with LangChain or a comparable framework is preferred.
Experience applying AI-enabled development practices to achieve measurable improvements in engineering productivity, quality or automation.
Strong knowledge of microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, PostgreSQL, automated testing and CI/CD.
Ability to translate business requirements into incremental production outcomes and clearly communicate technical options, risks and trade-offs to business and technology stakeholders.
A growth mindset and the ability to evaluate emerging technologies, turn experiments into production capabilities and balance innovation with security, resilience and regulatory controls.
Excellent written and spoken English.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Summary
Designs and implements robust technical solutions that enable critical business operations and enhance customer experience. Ensures system reliability, security, and performance standards are met while driving innovation and operational efficiency. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures that support the bank's digital transformation objectives.
Key Responsibilities
We are seeking a talented and motivated senior JAVA software engineer to join a high performing Scrum team to roll out new digital solution for customers. The candidate must be a skilled professional who has high availability software development experience with a desire to work on an Agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure
Design and develop the business logic and backend systems of the product
Work closely with frontend developers to design and develop functional, performing and complete APIs
Decipher existing companies’ software systems and be able to hook in application to applicable data sources
Write both unit and integration tests, and develop automation tools for daily tasks
Develop high quality, well documented, and efficient code
Challenge ideas and opinions to avoid pitfalls and inefficient solutions
Collaborate with product managers and other tech leads to ensure applications meet functional requirements and strategic objectives.
Perform code reviews to guarantee quality and promote a culture of technical excellence in Java development.
Skills And Experience
Java
Spring/SpringBoot
Restful API
Docker/K8s
Postgre/DB2/Oracle
Maven/Gradle
DevOps/ADO
Motivations
Environment: Collaborative, matrix environments where building relationships across functions is essential for success Dynamic settings with competing priorities that require strong organizational and time management skills Inclusive team cultures that value diverse perspectives and encourage open dialogue
Outcomes: Delivering high-quality solutions that directly impact business objectives and client satisfaction Contributing to process improvements that enhance team efficiency and reduce operational risk Building sustainable systems and practices that create long-term organizational value]
Challenges: Complex problem-solving that requires both analytical thinking and creative approaches Stakeholder management situations requiring influence without direct authority Technical challenges that push the boundaries of current capabilities and require continuous learning
Growth: Opportunities to develop both technical depth and business breadth Mentoring and knowledge-sharing that contributes to team capability building Exposure to emerging technologies and industry best practices
Qualifications
We are seeking a talented and motivated senior JAVA software engineer to join a high performing Scrum team to roll out new digital solution for customers. The candidate must be a skilled professional who has high availability software development experience with a desire to work on an Agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or related field, with preference given to advanced degrees.
Minimum experience of 5 years in Java application development.
Proficient in RESTful API, SOAP, JDK, SpringBoot 3.x, k8s, JUnit.
Should have knowledge on Relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and/or No-SQL Databases and ability to write basic SQL queries.
Preferred to have knowledge on API Gateways, API security, SSL, OAuth 2, etc.
Develop and maintain messaging services using JMS/Solace/Kafaka.
Should be independently able to manage CICD tasks using Git, Azure DevOps (ADO), Maven, Ansible, and Helm Charts
Experienced in Container Infrastructure such as Docker, Linux, Kubernetes, OCP or AWS EKS or Azure AKS. Implement microservices architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.
Have a high enthusiasm for programming and new technology learning, have a strong learning ability.
Fluent English speaking/listening/reading/writing. Mandarin or Cantonese language ability will be an advantage.
About Standard Chartered
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Together We
Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
What We Offer
In line with our Fair Pay Charter,
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

为内控失效造成的重大损失负责。

Education: University graduate with 5+ years of working experience in banking and related financial institutions. Deep understanding of structured products pricing; familiar with derivatives with underlying of equity, fixed income and currency;
Certifications: Post-graduate degree holder or CFA are preferred.
Languages: Excellent written and spoken English and Mandarin.
Qualifications
Microsoft Excel
Microsoft PowerPoint
Microsoft Word
Capital Markets Products Skills
About Standard Chartered
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Together We
Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
What We Offer
In line with our Fair Pay Charter,
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.
